t: The Werner Aluminium folding work platform provides a stable and portable elevated workspace for a range of trade tasks. This robust fixed height platform, measuring 500mm high with a 1.15m x 300mm anti-slip surface, ensures secure footing. Its lightweight aluminium construction and dual self-locking legs offer both safety and ease of use. Ideal for professional painters, decorators, and general contractors on site, it supports a maximum static load of 150kg. The platform folds completely flat for convenient transport and storage in a van or workshop, while non-marring feet protect delicate floor surfaces during work.
